title: A New Concept of the Universe
author: Walter Russell
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 600">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bgGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#0a0e1a;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#1c2a4d;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="coreGlow" cx="50%" cy="45%" r="40%" fx="50%" fy="45%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#fff7e6;stop-opacity:0.4" />
      <stop offset="60%" style="stop-color:#d4af37;stop-opacity:0.1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#000;stop-opacity:0" />
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="goldGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#bf953f;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="25%" style="stop-color:#fcf6ba;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#b38728;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="75%" style="stop-color:#fcf6ba;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#aa771c;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="400" height="600" fill="url(#bgGrad)" />

  <!-- Abstract Geometry: Wave Cycle and Light -->
  <circle cx="200" cy="270" r="180" fill="url(#coreGlow)" />
  
  <!-- Wave Path (The Octave Wave) -->
  <path d="M 50 270 Q 125 100 200 270 T 350 270" stroke="url(#goldGrad)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.6" />
  <path d="M 50 270 Q 125 440 200 270 T 350 270" stroke="url(#goldGrad)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.6" />

  <!-- Stylized Gyroscopic Rings -->
  <ellipse cx="200" cy="270" rx="140" ry="60" stroke="#d4af37" stroke-width="0.5" fill="none" transform="rotate(30, 200, 270)" opacity="0.4" />
  <ellipse cx="200" cy="270" rx="140" ry="60" stroke="#d4af37" stroke-width="0.5" fill="none" transform="rotate(-30, 200, 270)" opacity="0.4" />
  <circle cx="200" cy="270" r="5" fill="#fff" />

  <!-- Title Text -->
  <g style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; text-anchor: middle;">
    <text x="200" y="100" fill="url(#goldGrad)" font-size="18" letter-spacing="4" font-weight="300">A NEW CONCEPT</text>
    <text x="200" y="135" fill="url(#goldGrad)" font-size="14" letter-spacing="8">OF THE</text>
    <text x="200" y="180" fill="#fff" font-size="34" font-weight="bold" letter-spacing="2">UNIVERSE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Decorative Border -->
  <rect x="20" y="20" width="360" height="560" fill="none" stroke="#d4af37" stroke-width="0.5" opacity="0.5" />

  <!-- Author Section -->
  <line x1="150" y1="510" x2="250" y2="510" stroke="url(#goldGrad)" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="200" y="540" fill="#d4af37" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="3">WALTER RUSSELL</text>
  <text x="200" y="560" fill="#fff" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0.7" letter-spacing="1">The Russell Cosmogony</text>
</svg>
